title: Lead IT Business Analyst
description:
Lead IT Business Analyst
Full Time Perm
Way of Work : Hybrid - 3 days on location Tu/Wed/Thurs
Salary: $113,500 - $170,300, plus 10% annual bonus
Location : Columbus, OH

NiSource is one of the largest fully regulated utility companies in the U.S., serving millions of customers across six states. We’re more than an energy provider—we’re a team committed to innovation, inclusion, and growth. At NiSource, you’ll find a workplace that encourages collaboration, supports professional development, and empowers employees to make an impact.

Customer Transformation team supports NiSource’s multi-year effort to modernize customer experience through changes to process, technology, and ways of working. This role partners with business leaders, SMEs, IT, and vendors to define future-state processes, validate requirements, and streamline workflows.

The Lead IT Analyst is responsible for identifying, defining and documenting business requirements and functional specifications for Customer Information Systems Transformation project and initiatives by collaborating with service providers, business partners, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.

As a Lead IT Analyst, you will act as a liaison between the business, IT, and other project stakeholders. This role will be primarily assigned to the customer transformation team where they will help maintain a subset of applications, execution of application projects, assist with requirements gathering and coordination within an agile or waterfall team.

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

- Review and approve business requirements, functional specifications, and process documentation.

- Ensure consistency and quality across all BA deliverables.

- Manage requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

- Maintain Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) and ensure traceability from requirements through testing and deployment.

- Review solution designs for alignment with business objectives.

- Oversee RICEFW and workstream deliverables including Functional Designs (FD), Technical Designs (TD), Functional Unit Testing (FUT), and related project artifacts.

- Track status, dependencies, risks, and issues across assigned workstreams.

- Coordinate business validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

- Ensure requirements are adequately tested, and defects are resolved.

- Participate in defect triage and production readiness reviews.

- Work with PM to maintain RAID logs and drive issue resolution activities.

- Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

- Escalate critical issues when necessary and facilitate resolution.

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

- 8+ years of progressive IT Business Analysis experience

- 3+ years of experience leading Business Analysts and/or complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives

- Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale business and technology transformation programs

- Advanced skills in requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and translating business needs into actionable requirements

- Experience working across Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies

- Proficiency with JIRA, Qtest, Tricentis Tosca, or comparable project and work management tools

Preferred Qualifications

- Utility industry experience.

- Customer Information System (CIS) implementation experience.

- SAP IS-U, SAP S/4HANA, or similar enterprise platform experience.

- CBAP, PMI-PBA, Agile BA, or equivalent certification.

- Experience managing third-party vendors and system integrators.

Disclaimer

The preceding description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required of the position.

***Please note there is a short open-ended questionnaire to complete regarding your work experience towards the end of the application. This questionnaire can take up 10 - 15 minutes to complete.***

title: Director, Portfolio Planning & Origination (hybrid)
location_raw: Columbus OH - Arena District; Merrillville IN-SLC
description:
Director, Portfolio Planning & Origination

We are looking to hire someone to work in either our Columbus, Ohio or Merrillville, IN office (3 days/week hybrid schedule)

Job Summary
The Director, Portfolio Planning & Origination is responsible for leading and maintaining a goal-driven, team-oriented culture within the department when interfacing with other departments, and with external stakeholders. The Director will deliver the required origination, energy supply planning, and regulatory support to meet the needs of all stakeholders within NiSource/NIPSCO. The Director will be the lead commercial contact in constructing RFP's (Request for Proposals) for electric capacity to meet the needs of NIPSCO's customers. The Director will select winning bidders and will engage in arms-length negotiations for all long-term supply deals required by the utility as defined within the Integrated Resource Plan or other long-term planning endeavors/construct. The Director will be responsible for managing the capacity position of the utility by purchasing in the open market, via RFPs, or through the applicable auction processes so the company will remain balanced between necessary supply and existing demand. The Director will lead, direct, and oversee existing generation commercial agreements representing over $5 Billion of capital investment across Indiana and Kentucky to meet NIPSCO's near-term capacity needs through 2030. Further, the Director will lead, direct, and oversee the Operations & Market Support, Regulatory Support, Market Settlements (MISO, RTO/ISO, and Bilateral settlements), and Commercial Support departments, and will partner with internal stakeholders to achieve the business objectives of the organization. These groups provide market and technical support to departments including Regulatory, Regulatory Policy, Financial Planning, Accounting, Risk, Environmental, Tax, Legal, etc. as well as ad hoc requests by any other department.

Essential Functions

- Supervise department personnel, manage the O&M budget and communicate applicable impacts to corporate O&M/CAPEX.

- Mentor, coach, and provide training to direct reports to ensure on-going development of the department.

- Lead all short-term and long-term generation capacity replacement activities.

- Lead the design and review of Requests for Proposals to address changing electric capacity needs. Lead commercial negotiations for asset acquisitions, purchase power agreements, or other off-take/M&A transactions to meet the energy supply needs of the Company and its Customers.

- Lead the on-going management of existing generation supply agreements (3,400 MW) totaling over $5 Billion in capital investment and $2 Billion in utility rate-base.

- Provide and support required testimony in CPCN, FERC, or other filings to support energy supply needs.

- Support tax equity financing and the due-diligence of asset acquisition constructs.

- Support the successful onboarding and market registration of new generation assets.

- Partner with Risk, Credit, and Treasury groups to creatively address potential counterparty and deal risk.

- Partner with necessary internal/external business partners in the creation of Board of Director materials, resolutions, and approvals.

- Direct the development and support of production costing computer models (PROMOD-Electric, Plexos – Gas).

- Provide and coordinate testimony and forecasts as required to support NiSource/NIPSCO’s involvement in the broader energy markets (e.g. FAC, GCA, RA, RTO, etc. – cost recovery trackers).

- Respond to Data Requests as required pursuant to audits, regulatory proceedings, or government investigations; participate in internal and external audits as required.

- Lead and coordinate all Energy Supply & Optimization related NIPSCO Gas and Electric Rate Case activities; write and review Rate Case testimony and provide timely responses to Rate Case Data Request Items.

- Interface with Regulatory, Finance, and Regulatory Policy departments in the development and review of Tariffs and Riders and in some instances lead the development of market-facing Tariffs and Riders.

- Assist Regulatory, Finance, and Accounting in performing the gas and electric monthly closing processes to include Resource Cost and Allocation, MISO Market Settlements, Gas Settlements and Planning.

- Provide forecast updates to Financial Planning to include Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).

- Ensure timely and accurate reconciliation and verification of all market settlement activity.

- Provide ad hoc analysis and forecasting in support of the Hedging Policy and lead the development of applicable hedging programs.

- Lead certain applicable market-facing interventions/engagement pursuant to FERC matters, MISO Market Stakeholder processes, Independent Market Monitor (MISO/PJM), etc.

Required Qualifications For Position

- Bachelor's Degree In Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent.

- Extensive experience with wholesale electric market operations, gas trading, commercial negotiations/origination, renewable energy and deployment of battery storage.

- Minimum of 10 years of work experience in the electric utility, gas utility, or a related industry.

- Experience in leading a complex department covering a multitude of origination, market-facing, and regulatory-based processes

- Must have outstanding planning, organizational, verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to perform duties effectively under normal, emergency, and contingency situations.

- Knowledge of regulatory processes, plant operations, fuel supply, project development (origination, permitting, and associated processes), rates, tariffs, State and Federal regulations, and gas operations.

- Financially competent in the areas of general accounting, financial statement analysis, general tax awareness (specifically renewable tax incentives) and an understating of credit ratings/other forms of securitization.

- Knowledge of rates, tariffs, cost allocation, and billing functions.

- Possess a working understanding of regulatory processes, bulk power generation, wholesale power markets, and renewable/thermal generation.

- Working understanding of market trends, deal structures, and legal “deal” making processes.

- Track record of commercial success from origination of commercial agreements and supporting those agreements through deal origination, regulatory approvals, construction, tax equity financing, asset in-service, and agreement tenure (10+ years or through applicable statute of limitations).

Preferred Additional Qualifications for Position

- Master's Degree In Business Administration or equivalent

title: Intern IT - Software Engineer
location_raw: Merrillville IN-SLC; Columbus OH - Arena District
description:
NiSource Internship Program Introduction
NiSource is currently seeking a Summer IT - Software Engineer Intern. Successful applicants will become integral members of the department while learning within a team environment, completing meaningful tasks and collaborating with team members and leaders on important projects. This position will be a great opportunity for the candidate desiring to launch their career in this field. Successful applicants will build professional relationships with other interns and all levels of NiSource personnel while participating in rewarding professional development exercises and fun, team-building activities. Interns will obtain a broad overview of NiSource's operations and current events in the utilities industry.

This is a 12-week summer internship program starting in May 2027, for students entering their junior or senior year in fall 2027. The role is based in Columbus, OH or Merrillville, IN. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the reporting location to be eligible.

Essential Functions

- Enterprise Architecture
• Enterprise Architecture is responsible for creating the technology strategy and roadmap. This team is responsible for developing standards and guidelines that should be used in planning, designing and implementing Information Technology applications and platforms. This team works collaboratively with other groups to drive the architecture vision for NiSource.

- IT Services
• The Services supports the delivery of IT Application and Infrastructure services, including hardware and software asset and configuration management, for all NiSource business units. This role works with the Manager of IT Service Integration, Manager of IT Service Governance and other Technology Tower Leads to ensure that Infrastructure and Application Services are fully integrated and delivered within the scope of Service Provider Contracts as reflected by service levels, statements of work and pertinent schedules/exhibits.

- Infrastructure
• Infrastructure, network delivery, primary responsibility is to provide network technical design leadership and to oversee execution of processes associated incident, problem, change, asset, and configuration management within this technology domain. This includes working with enterprise architects, program managers, IT analysts and managed service providers to effectively manage infrastructure operations and support delivery of Infrastructure projects. It also includes development and periodic review of ITIL based processes and practices to ensure highly available operations and compliance with architecture standards and strategies.

- IT Security
• The IT Security organization is responsible for the resolution of IT Security incidents; manages preparation & planning for future IT security threats, and follows security trends, threats and vulnerabilities. This role will work on a project to develop and execute a specific cyber incident response scenario exercise and develop a broad-view perspective of the cybersecurity space. Incident response improvement with better Integration of security and IT Operations processes. Work across towers to understand the interrelationships between IT Operations processes, and our company as a whole.

- IT Applications

- The IT Applications Developer Job Family encompasses job responsibilities and accountability for various IT applications development, system administration, and support functions necessary to ensure a stable and reliable application environment for NiSource. The application environment encompasses mission critical information systems such as Gas distribution, Hydro and Electrical Grid control systems, Electronic Measurement and other business critical applications. The job also includes the analysis and development of business applications, system interfaces, and other duties related to application system development lifecycle.

- Business Analytics

• The Business Analytics Intern will leverage their skillset in areas such as data discovery, modeling and visualizing results to identify and discover patterns throughout the business. Through collaboration with business units, this professional will be capable of acquiring, cleansing and structuring data from multiple sources to deliver key analytics based insight to drive business decisions.

Required Qualifications For Position

- Acquiring a degree in data science, computer science, computer engineering, statistics, mathematics

- GPA of 3.0 or higher

- Have completed at least one year of undergraduate study

- Experience with cloud, software development, data analytics, automation, or enterprise technologies

- Keen attention to detail and a quality focused mindset

- Strong oral and written communication skills

- Self-discipline for planning and organizing tasks

- Passionate about data

- History of being able to learn new technology quickly

- Solid skills in utilizing computers, operating systems, mobile devices and software (MS Office Suite, MS Project, and other IT applications).

- Excellent analytical abilities, including process analysis and development, problem-solving and root-cause analysis.

- Ability to work 40 hours per week

- Authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship
